evidence.MCL: There is complete tear of the medial collateral ligament, involving both the deep and superficial components at the femoral attachment with mild retraction.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Horizontal tear involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus with associated parameniscal cyst and two meniscal flap
evidence.Medial OA: Mild to moderate chondropathy involving medial and patellofemoral compartment.
evidence.PF OA: There is diffuse mild to moderate cartilage thinning with focal full-thickness cartilage loss at the trochlea.
evidence.Baker's: There is a small popliteal cyst measuring 1.3 cm x 0.7 cm x 1.6 cm
evidence.Contusion: Bone contusion involving lateral femoral condyle
evidence.Fracture: possible mild impaction fracture within the posterior aspect.
